Our Solid Oak Shelves are crafted to order, available in a variety of widths and lengths. 40mm thick solid oak, hand planed and sanded. Available with hidden fixings (pre-drilled) or black metal brackets.

What you receive:

  • Solid Oak Shelf 40mm thick in selected size
  • Choice of hidden or black metal brackets
  • Oiled finish (oil colour on request)
  • Pre-drilled for concealed fixings

Note: oak is a natural product and may have individual characteristics such as cracks, shakes, or knots — these are features, not flaws.
